skill.name: heurist-mesh-skill
skill.description: Access live crypto token data, DeFi metrics, wallet intelligence, project research, and Heurist Mesh payment workflows through documented REST API agents.
skill.summary: Query Heurist Mesh agents for live crypto, DeFi, wallet, social, and project intelligence.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: The skill is an expected networked crypto research connector, and many Markdown backtick findings are false positives. Real risks remain: private key and API key handling, paid payment flows, external command examples, temporary signing files, and pipe-to-shell Foundry install commands. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell installation with a package manager, pinned release, checksum verification, or a manual install link.

remediation.issue: Wallet and Inflow private keys stored in .env
remediation.suggestion: Use a hardware wallet, dedicated low-balance signer, or secret vault, and avoid exposing raw keys to agents.
Require explicit user approval, visible price information, a maximum spend limit, and retry caps before paid requests.
Use a secure temporary file with restricted permissions and cleanup, or sign from memory when possible.

remediation.issue: External endpoint and data sharing exposure
remediation.suggestion: Document all third-party endpoints and describe which queries, wallet addresses, and payment metadata are sent.

semantic_findings.title: Agent-Mediated Paid Transaction Flow
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs agents to configure API keys, wallet private keys, or Inflow credentials before calling paid Mesh APIs. The x402 path signs and submits USDC payment headers, so missing spend caps or per-call consent can cause unintended charges.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited files explicitly require payment setup and describe signed or approved paid request flows. Inflow includes approval, but x402 relies on signing with a private key and needs stronger spend controls.

content.user_title: Analyze Crypto Markets with Heurist Mesh
content.value_statement: Crypto research needs live token, wallet, DeFi, and social data from many sources. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to query Heurist Mesh agents through documented API flows.
actual_capabilities: Discover available Heurist Mesh agents and fetch current tool schemas.
Query trending token data, market summaries, and token profiles.
Compare DeFi protocol metrics, chain metrics, TVL, fees, and revenue.
Look up wallet token holdings, NFT collections, and EVM address labels.
Run project research, Twitter/X intelligence, and deep crypto analysis jobs.
limitations: Requires network access to Heurist Mesh and related payment providers.
Requires an API key, x402 wallet key, or Inflow payment setup before API calls.
May incur fees through credits, x402 payments, or Inflow approval.
Does not independently verify investment advice or market predictions.

use_cases.title: Monitor Token Momentum
use_cases.description: Track trending tokens, market summaries, and notable social signals before preparing a market brief.

use_cases.title: Compare Protocol Metrics
use_cases.description: Review TVL, fees, revenue, chain coverage, and growth trends across DeFi protocols.

use_cases.title: Investigate Wallet Activity
use_cases.description: Summarize wallet holdings, NFT collections, address labels, and related project context.

prompt_templates.title: Check Trending Tokens
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a quick market snapshot.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Heurist Mesh to show tokens trending now. Include the agent used, key metrics, and a short risk note.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Token Profile
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for token due diligence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve [TOKEN] with TokenResolverAgent, fetch its profile, and summarize market pairs, indicators, and funding data.

prompt_templates.title: Compare DeFi Protocols
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch current metrics for [PROTOCOL A] and [PROTOCOL B]. Compare TVL, fees, chains, revenue, and recent growth.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Agent Market Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow using discovery, schemas, and paid call controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Discover the best Heurist Mesh agents for [MARKET QUESTION]. Fetch schemas, run only necessary paid calls, and produce a sourced brief.

output_examples.input: What tokens are trending right now?
output_examples.output: A ranked token brief with volume, social attention, recent price movement, and caveats about volatility.

output_examples.input: Compare Uniswap and Aave activity this week.
output_examples.output: A protocol comparison covering TVL, fees, revenue, chain coverage, growth direction, and notable differences.

output_examples.input: Review this wallet for major holdings and labels.
output_examples.output: A wallet summary with token balances, NFT collections, address labels, estimated value, and risk notes.

best_practices: Fetch the current agent schema before each new workflow.
Confirm pricing, credentials, and payment method before any paid API call.
Ask the user to disambiguate tokens, wallets, or projects before expensive follow-up calls.
anti_patterns: Do not expose API keys or private keys in chat, logs, or shared files.
Do not make paid calls before setup, pricing, and user intent are clear.
Do not treat agent research output as investment advice.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It connects to Heurist Mesh agents for crypto market, wallet, DeFi, social, and project research data.

faq.question: Does it require payment?
faq.answer: Yes. Calls require credits, x402 payment, or Inflow approval, depending on the selected path.

faq.question: Can it work without network access?
faq.answer: No. The skill depends on live external API calls to retrieve current data.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it store private keys safely?
faq.answer: The source documents .env storage, which requires caution. Use safer secret storage when possible.

faq.question: Is the output financial advice?
faq.answer: No. Outputs are research summaries and should be reviewed before making financial decisions.
